problem_text:
A logistics company must select packages to load onto a delivery truck. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 27 cubic feet, revenue $264
* Package 2: volume 13 cubic feet, revenue $95
* Package 3: volume 26 cubic feet, revenue $34
* Package 4: volume 50 cubic feet, revenue $183
* Package 5: volume 49 cubic feet, revenue $276
* Package 6: volume 13 cubic feet, revenue $177
* Package 7: volume 12 cubic feet, revenue $275
* Package 8: volume 35 cubic feet, revenue $232
* Package 9: volume 10 cubic feet, revenue $262
* Package 10: volume 43 cubic feet, revenue $119
* Package 11: volume 39 cubic feet, revenue $235
* Package 12: volume 3 cubic feet, revenue $134
* Package 13: volume 32 cubic feet, revenue $172
* Package 14: volume 36 cubic feet, revenue $110
* Package 15: volume 1 cubic feet, revenue $32

The truck has a maximum cargo capacity of 272 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package is either fully loaded or left behind.
